make_event: Inject the clock so tests can fix the time.
Generate a missing correlation_id with str(uuid.uuid4()); timestamp = clock().isoformat().
latency_summary: rank = math.ceil(0.95 * n); p95 = ordered[rank - 1]; statistics.median for the median.
error_budget: Round DOWN with math.floor; add a tiny epsilon against float error.
serialize_user: Build {'id', 'name'}; for v2 add user.get('email'); other versions raise ValueError.
error_envelope: Don't leak internals on server errors.
For status >= 500 the message becomes 'Internal server error'.
iterate_cursor: Keep a set of seen cursors and raise RuntimeError on a repeat; stop when the cursor is None.
IdempotencyStore: Look up the key before running the action.
Store json.dumps(result) only after action() succeeds, inside `with conn:`.
should_alert: Look only at the last `sustained` samples.
Fewer samples than `sustained` means no alert; otherwise all of them must be > threshold.
readiness: A check that raises counts as failed.
Wrap each probe in try/except; ready = every result is 'ok'.
migrate: PRAGMA user_version stores the schema version.
Apply migrations[v:] one at a time, each in `with conn:`, setting user_version = i + 1.
parse_version: Exactly 3 parts, all .isdigit(); return a tuple of ints.
is_compatible: The server's minor version must be >= the client's.
